info.title: GenAI Tool Definitions
info.description: Schema for the gen_ai.tool.definitions attribute, describing the list of tool definitions available to a GenAI model.

ToolDefinitions.description: Represents the list of tool definitions available to the GenAI model.

FunctionToolDefinition.description: Represents a tool definition in the form of a function that is executed on the client.

parameters.description: JSON Schema document describing the parameters accepted by the tool.

ServerSideToolDefinition.description: Represents a tool definition for a capability that the model provider manages on the server.
ServerSideToolDefinition.x-otel-deviation: OTel defines a GenericToolDefinition with a required name. In practice, tools are local functions or server-side capabilities, and the latter may only have a type.
